content_of_post_to_answer: Why do some people become increasingly selfish as they get older, while others become more generous?
answer: Age doesn't automatically make people selfish or generous; it often amplifies what they have learned about the world. Repeated disappointments can make someone protect their time, money, and trust, while meaningful relationships can make another person more giving. The difference is partly whether experience teaches you that people are a threat to guard against or human beings worth investing in. Growing older changes your circumstances; how you interpret those experiences shapes your character.
